text:
The Senators' latest video is titled "'Different Level This Year': Stützle's Growth Continues," and the most surprising line in Tim Stützle's season backs it up: 38 hits in 17 games. TSN's Mike Johnson spent a segment this week on the evolution of his 200-foot game, which matters because defense was the knock. Evolving-Hockey had opponents' chances rising with him on the ice last season, bottom 4% among forwards.

This year the shot attempts with him out there are roughly even (49% at five on five), but the quality isn't: Ottawa takes 58% of the expected goals. Fewer attempts, better ones. That's what a more complete player looks like, though 17 games is a small sample for anything defensive.

His 9 goals carry some luck, 23% shooting after 18% last season, so expect a few fewer to go in. Graeme Nichols of Coming Down the Pipe has been tracking Dylan Cozens' production since the move to Stützle's wing; that partnership is what we'd watch next. At 24, our projection has him near 96 points.
headline: Stützle's game is getting longer
